title: Systematic review of gallbladder disorders: Molecular pathogenesis, biomarkers, diagnostic approaches, and emerging therapeutic strategies.
snippet: Gallbladder cancer (GBC) is the most aggressive and lethal malignancy of the biliary tract, characterized by rapid disease progression, early invasion, and poor survival rates.
